annotations.title: Get all Sets from a Family

description: Use this right after choosing a Family of icons, to see its Sets and take one Set's `slug`. Not for searching Sets by meaning (`search_sets`). Next: `search_assets` with that `slug` as `setSlug`. Returns all Sets belonging to a specific Family. Paginated with offset (default 0) and limit (default 100, max 100). Call this after choosing a Family with `search_families` and before recommending it: it is what surfaces the Family's actual Sets to the user, and recommending a visual style they cannot see is a failed answer however good the prose. Also use it to list a Family's Sets when the user is browsing with no query to match — reach for `search_sets` when there is one. Pass the Family `familyHash` from get_all_families (`hash` on each row) or from find_sets_by_name (`familyHash`) when available.

familyHash.description: The hash of the Family (top-level bundle). Legacy alternative to `familySlug`; use `familyHash` from find_sets_by_name when that is all you have.

familySlug.description: The slug of the Family (top-level bundle). Preferred over `familyHash`. Use `slug` from `search_families` or `get_all_families`.

limit.description: Maximum number of Sets to return (default: 100, max: 100).

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default: 0).

name: get_all_sets_from_family
title: Get all Sets from a Family
